name: Call setup time per Operator and Campaign
description: Average and maximum call setup time of the completed calls.
query_sql:
SELECT Operator, Campaign,
  COUNT(*) AS Calls,
  ROUND(AVG(setup_time_seconds), 2) AS Avg_Setup_Time_s,
  ROUND(MAX(setup_time_seconds), 2) AS Max_Setup_Time_s
FROM selected_voice
WHERE Call_Status = 'Completed' AND setup_time_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Operator, Campaign
ORDER BY Operator, Campaign
